assignment_rule: A mission becomes canonical only after issuer, assignee, objective, location/route, timing, authority/reward, known information, hidden facts, opposition, and success/failure conditions are committed before player tactics.

archetypes.description: Protect a political envoy across a seeded route under diplomatic constraints.
Protect a merchant caravan with fixed cargo, route, schedule, and threat state.
Inspect a fortification, supplies, command readiness, and repair needs.
Recover or exchange a captured person through force, negotiation, ransom, or covert action.
Locate and suppress an identified raider group under the assigned legal and territorial constraints.
Investigate a governor, official, depot, or tax office using evidence and political authority.
Protect engineers, surveyors, or a works project through a defined risk window.
Identify a spy, leak, or compromised courier chain from available evidence.
Acquire enemy plans or records from the assigned location.
Damage or delay an identified enemy siege train.
Extract an intelligence contact or agent from a seeded location.
Survey a pass, road, river crossing, or enemy approach and return actionable information.
Secure, defend, repair, seize, or deny a bridge according to the issued orders.
Command an assigned detachment for the stated operational objective.
Screen a larger army movement using cavalry, scouts, terrain, and information.
Hold a crossing until a fixed condition, deadline, or withdrawal order.
Raid a defined supply node or convoy using existing logistics state.
Protect siege works and crews from a pre-seeded enemy response.
Maintain a route for withdrawing forces under actual casualty, terrain, and morale conditions.
Resolve a tax, jurisdiction, or privilege dispute involving House Tang through lawful, political, or coercive means.
Handle a marriage/alliance proposal without presuming Tang Wei consent or family outcome.
Resolve an embargo, contract failure, toll dispute, or merchant pressure.
Handle an incident involving a Sword Manor member, patron, rival school, or local authority.
Resolve payment, casualties, scope, replacement, or employer disagreement with a mercenary company.
Negotiate or execute a prisoner exchange with explicit custody and security state.
